item.text:
I tightened the domain API around value semantics and matrix export.

`[FlowNetwork.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/FlowNetwork.java:5)` now has a named factory, a primary `toCapacityMatrix()` export, and proper `equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`, so it behaves like a real value object instead of a wrapper around `int[][]`. `[FlowProblem.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/FlowProblem.java:36)` and `[MaxFlowResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/MaxFlowResult.java:43)` now have matching value semantics too, which makes the core model easier to compare, log, and test.

I also centralized matrix helpers in `[IntMatrix.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/IntMatrix.java:13)` and aligned the residual export path with that design. `[ResidualNetwork.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/ResidualNetwork.java:38)` now converts back to a `FlowNetwork` through the same API, and `[MaxFlowResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/MaxFlowResult.java:31)` exposes `residualCapacities()` as the consistent raw-matrix view while keeping the older compatibility methods.

Verification: `javac *.java` succeeded, and `java FordFulkersonMaxFlow` still prints `The maximum possible flow is 23`.
